1: import LidoSRv3.Audit.Source.SszProofLoopResources
2: /-! Iterated SSZ calldata, scratch and SHA primitives at core17005714.
3: The loop follows sourceStep's actual next offset and continuation flag. The
4: natural round bound is interpreter fuel, supplied as the decoded proof length
5: in the refinement theorem; it does not replace the source continuation check.
6: A conservative initial budget derives each CALL's resource admission. Surrounding
7: memory/control opcodes are not charged by these primitive semantics.
8: -/
9: namespace LidoSRv3.Audit.Source.SszProofCalldataLoop
10: open EvmYul EvmYul.EVM
11: open SszProofCalldataStep SszProofLoopResources SszShaCallMemory
12: 
13: def loop : Nat → Nat → EVM.State → UInt256 → UInt256 → UInt256 → UInt256 → Except StepError StepResult
14:   | 0, _, _, _, _, _, _ => .error .engineFailure
15:   | rounds+1, fuel, st, index, leaf, offset, endOffset => do
16:       let result ← sourceStep fuel st index leaf offset endOffset
17:       if result.continues then
18:         loop rounds fuel result.state result.index result.leaf result.offset endOffset
19:       else .ok result
20: 
21: def budget (rounds : Nat) : Nat := 2684 * rounds + 1
22: 
23: theorem word_ext {a b : UInt256} (h : a.toNat = b.toNat) : a = b :=
24:   congrArg UInt256.mk (Fin.ext h)
25: 
26: theorem ofNat_nat (w : UInt256) : UInt256.ofNat w.toNat = w := by
27:   apply word_ext
28:   exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt w.val.isLt
29: 
30: theorem layout_shift (prebytes suffix : ByteArray) (before rest : List UInt256) (a b : UInt256) :
31:     layout prebytes suffix before a (b::rest) = layout prebytes suffix (before++[a]) b rest := by
32:   simp [layout,List.append_assoc]
33: 
34: theorem end_shift (prebytes : ByteArray) (before rest : List UInt256) (a b : UInt256) :
35:     sourceEnd prebytes (before++a::b::rest).length =
36:       sourceEnd prebytes ((before++[a])++b::rest).length := by
37:   simp [List.append_assoc]
38: 
39: theorem step_complete (fuel : Nat) (st : EVM.State) (index leaf : UInt256)
40:     (prebytes suffix : ByteArray) (before after : List UInt256) (sibling : UInt256)
41:     (hlayout : st.executionEnv.calldata = layout prebytes suffix before sibling after)
42:     (hsize : st.executionEnv.calldata.size < UInt256.size)
43:     (hindex : 1 < index.toNat)
44:     (hdepth : st.executionEnv.depth < 1024)
45:     (hg : 2685 ≤ st.gasAvailable.toNat)
46:     (hout : (shaOutput (pairInput index leaf sibling)).size = 32)
47:     (hwidth : st.activeWords.toNat < 2^251) :
48:     ∃ result : StepResult,
49:       sourceStep fuel st index leaf (proofOffset prebytes before)
50:         (sourceEnd prebytes (before ++ sibling :: after).length) = .ok result ∧
51:       SszProofFold.sourceFold ffiPair index.toNat leaf [sibling] = .ok (result.index.toNat,result.leaf) ∧
52:       result.offset = proofOffset prebytes (before++[sibling]) ∧
53:       result.continues = decide (after ≠ []) ∧
54:       result.state.executionEnv = st.executionEnv ∧
55:       st.gasAvailable.toNat ≤ result.state.gasAvailable.toNat + 2684 ∧
56:       result.state.activeWords.toNat < 2^251 := by
57:   have hgp : 2685 ≤ (preparedStep st index leaf (proofOffset prebytes before)).gasAvailable.toNat := hg
58:   obtain ⟨hgas,hpaid⟩ := call_admitted (preparedStep st index leaf (proofOffset prebytes before)) hgp
59:   obtain ⟨result,hstep,hfold,hoff,hcont,_⟩ := sourceStep_success fuel st index leaf prebytes suffix before after sibling
60:     hlayout hsize hindex hdepth hgas hpaid hout hwidth
61:   obtain ⟨other,hother,henv,hgasEq,hwords⟩ := step_resources fuel st index leaf prebytes suffix before after sibling
62:     hlayout hsize hindex hdepth hg hout
63:   have heq : result = other := Except.ok.inj (hstep.symm.trans hother)
64:   subst other
65:   have hcursor : cursor prebytes (before++[sibling]) = cursor prebytes before + 32 := by
66:     simp [cursor,List.length_append,Nat.mul_add,Nat.add_assoc]
67:   have hOffset : result.offset = proofOffset prebytes (before++[sibling]) := by
68:     rw [proofOffset,hcursor,← hoff,ofNat_nat]
69:   refine ⟨result,hstep,hfold,hOffset,hcont,henv,?_,?_⟩
70:   · have haccess := access_le st
71:     omega
72:   · rw [hwords]
73:     omega

87:     (h : SszProofFold.sourceFold hash index leaf [sibling] = .ok (next,digest)) :
88:     SszProofFold.sourceFold hash index leaf (sibling::rest) =
89:       SszProofFold.sourceFold hash next digest rest := by
90:   simp only [SszProofFold.sourceFold] at h ⊢
91:   split at h
92:   · cases h
93:   · split at h
94:     · cases h

101:     (hi : index.toNat ≤ 1) : loop (rounds+1) fuel st index leaf offset ending = .error .extraItem := by
102:   simp only [loop,sourceStep_extra fuel st index leaf offset ending hi]
103:   rfl

106:     (hi : index.toNat ≤ 1) :
107:     SszProofFold.sourceFold ffiPair index.toNat leaf (sibling::rest) = .error .extraItem := by
108:   have hp : index.toNat / 2 = 0 := by omega

111: open SszWordBytes

113: /-- All observed outcomes of the nonempty primitive loop match the existing
114: FFI-backed word fold. Layout, initial representation/depth and opaque hash
115: output length remain explicit; per-iteration gas is derived, not supplied.
116: This does not assert standardSha, cryptography or compiled opcode execution. -/
117: theorem loop_refines (rest : List UInt256) (fuel : Nat) (st : EVM.State)
118:     (index leaf sibling : UInt256) (prebytes suffix : ByteArray) (before : List UInt256)
119:     (hlayout : st.executionEnv.calldata = layout prebytes suffix before sibling rest)
120:     (hsize : st.executionEnv.calldata.size < UInt256.size)
121:     (hdepth : st.executionEnv.depth < 1024)
122:     (hg : budget (rest.length+1) ≤ st.gasAvailable.toNat)
123:     (hffi : ∀ left right : UInt256,
124:       (shaOutput (fixedBE 32 left.toNat ++ fixedBE 32 right.toNat)).size = 32)
125:     (hwidth : st.activeWords.toNat < 2^251) :
126:     observe (loop (rest.length+1) fuel st index leaf (proofOffset prebytes before)
127:       (sourceEnd prebytes (before++sibling::rest).length)) =
128:       foldProjection (SszProofFold.sourceFold ffiPair index.toNat leaf (sibling::rest)) := by
129:   induction rest generalizing st index leaf sibling before with
130:   | nil =>
131:     by_cases hi : index.toNat ≤ 1
132:     · rw [loop_extra _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hi,fold_extra _ _ _ _ hi]
133:       rfl
134:     · have hout : (shaOutput (pairInput index leaf sibling)).size = 32 := by
135:         unfold pairInput
136:         split <;> apply hffi
137:       obtain ⟨result,hstep,hfold,hoff,hcont,henv,hcost,hwords⟩ := step_complete fuel st index leaf
138:         prebytes suffix before [] sibling hlayout hsize (by omega) hdepth (by simpa [budget] using hg) hout hwidth

147:     · rw [loop_extra _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hi,fold_extra _ _ _ _ hi]
148:       rfl
149:     · have hout : (shaOutput (pairInput index leaf sibling)).size = 32 := by
150:         unfold pairInput

152:       have hgas : 2685 ≤ st.gasAvailable.toNat := by
153:         simp only [budget,List.length_cons,Nat.mul_add,Nat.mul_one] at hg
154:         omega
155:       obtain ⟨result,hstep,hfold,hoff,hcont,henv,hcost,hwords⟩ := step_complete fuel st index leaf
156:         prebytes suffix before (second::rest) sibling hlayout hsize (by omega) hdepth hgas hout hwidth

"import LidoSRv3.Audit.Source.SszWrapperIndex

/-!
Digest-carrying interpretation of SSZ.sol:179-249 at
lidofinance/core@17005714f151e5502c559932319a3f2f74ac2436.
Typed proof elements replace calldata accesses; calldata pointer/end arithmetic
and scratch memory are not modeled. A successful SHA precompile is interpreted
as returning its complete digest. The source does NOT check returndatasize.
-/
namespace LidoSRv3.Audit.Source.SszProofFold

inductive Error where
  | invalidProof | extraItem | hashFailure | missingItem
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- A precompile may fail; success supplies the computed digest, not a match flag. -/
abbrev Hash (α : Type) := α → α → Option α

/-- The scratch side is selected from the CURRENT index, before shifting.
The parent-zero guard precedes the attempted hash. -/
def sourceFold (hash : Hash α) : Nat → α → List α → Except Error (Nat × α)
  | index, leaf, [] => .ok (index, leaf)
  | index, leaf, sibling :: rest =>
      let right := (index &&& 1) != 0
      let parent := index >>> 1
      if parent = 0 then .error .extraItem
      else
        match (if right then hash sibling leaf else hash leaf sibling) with
        | none => .error .hashFailure
        | some digest => sourceFold hash parent digest rest

/-- Entry gIndex is the source's decoded uint248, including zero and one.
The empty check is first. Missing siblings take priority over root mismatch. -/
def sourceVerify [DecidableEq α] (hash : Hash α)
    (index : Fin SszWrapperIndex.indexModulus) (leaf : α) (proof : List α)
    (root : α) : Except Error Unit :=
  if proof = [] then .error .invalidProof
  else do
    let (lastIndex, digest) ← sourceFold hash index.val leaf proof
    if lastIndex ≠ 1 then .error .missingItem
    else if digest = root then .ok () else .error .invalidProof

/-- Independent finite Merkle path. A parent at index n has children 2*n and
2*n+1, respectively. The proof lists siblings from leaf towards root. Unlike
the source, the specification constructs indices from a root at 1; it has no
shift, scratch offset, loop state, final-index check or executable equality. -/
inductive Branch (hash : Hash α) : Nat → α → List α → α → Prop where
  | root (digest : α) : Branch hash 1 digest [] digest
  | left {index : Nat} {leaf sibling parent root : α} {rest : List α}
      (hashed : hash leaf sibling = some parent)
      (above : Branch hash index parent rest root) :
      Branch hash (2 * index) leaf (sibling :: rest) root
  | right {index : Nat} {leaf sibling parent root : α} {rest : List α}
      (hashed : hash sibling leaf = some parent)
      (above : Branch hash index parent rest root) :
      Branch hash (2 * index + 1) leaf (sibling :: rest) root

/-- Full-depth bounds come from the structural path, not a supplied no-wrap bound. -/
theorem branch_interval {hash : Hash α} {index : Nat} {leaf root : α} {proof : List α}
    (h : Branch hash index leaf proof root) :
    2 ^ proof.length ≤ index ∧ index < 2 ^ (proof.length + 1) := by
  induction h with
  | root => simp
  | left hh ha ih =>
      simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.pow_succ] at *
      omega
  | right hh ha ih =>
      simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.pow_succ] at *
      omega

theorem branch_positive {hash : Hash α} {index : Nat} {leaf root : α} {proof : List α}
    (h : Branch hash index leaf proof root) : 0 < index :=
  lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.two_pow_pos _) (branch_interval h).1

theorem branch_depth {hash : Hash α} {index : Nat} {leaf root : α} {proof : List α}
    (h : Branch hash index leaf proof root) : index.log2 = proof.length := by
  exact (Nat.log2_eq_iff (by have := branch_positive h; omega)).mpr (branch_interval h)

/-- Construction of an independent path is sufficient for the executable fold. -/
